snippet.title: Arcadian Days | Official Alpha Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM AND PLAY THE DEMO TODAY https://store.steampowered.com/app/3610170/Arcadian_Days/

Arcadian Days is a highly relaxing and immersive exploration game where you grow along with the character! 

- Explore the unique and highly detailed land of Bucuria, brought to life by Unreal Engine 5. Highly open and non-linear, every corner can hold an interesting secret or new quest chain.
- Shape the narrative and how the land develops in numerous ways. 
- Discover the lore and stories of Bucuria, including its ancient and rich history. 
- Spend time and develop the relationship with your family and playful dog companion!

Join our socials today to find out more.
https://discord.gg/VpF4g5YmKW
